newsitem.title: USA: Covol Technologies says oven installed.
newsitem.headline: Covol Technologies says oven installed.

text.p: Covol Technologies Inc said on Friday that it had finished installing a new drying oven, allowing the plant to produce up to 360,000 tons per year of solid synthetic fuel using the Covol process.
Covol's patented recycling process converts small coal particles into a solid synthetic fuel.
The oven has a rated capacity of 70 million BTU's per hour and is capable of processing up to 70 tons per hour of solid synthetic fuel, the company said in a statement.
Covol said the Coaltech synthetic fuel processing facility where the oven was installed was its first full scale processing plant and another facility was under construction in Birmingham, Ala.
Covol Technologies Inc is a technology development company focused on recycling waste.
